description: Ledger of published gateway operations the routing contract declares unrouted. Every entry needs a reason; an entry whose operation becomes routable fails tools/check-cloudrouter-ai-routing-consistency.mjs until it is removed, so the ledger cannot rot into a permanent excuse. The per-API runtime probe (crates/sdkwork-cloudrouter-edge-runtime/tests/per_api_chain_e2e.rs) reads the entries that carry apiCode + failClosedScope and asserts the gateway fails closed on exactly that api scope.
